name: Republic Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longer, 14/32, is 6,833 ft x 150 ft (about 2,083 m)

curfew.v: voluntary curfew 22:00-07:00 local (an earlier mandatory curfew was overturned in court)
curfew.quote: The airport does have a voluntary curfew between 10pm and 7am.

customs.v: CBP clears arriving aircraft 7 days a week, 08:00-23:00 local; e-mail CBP before leaving the foreign airport and at least 24 hours before arrival; general aviation aircraft at most 20 passengers unless approved beforehand

notes: Owned by New York State and managed by NYSDOT. CBP fact sheet read is 11 Sep 2024; newer CBP versions (fact-sheet details page lists KFRG-0425 of 15 Apr 2025, and a Nov 2025 PDF) could not be opened, so confirm customs hours. Current Chart Supplement could not be opened. FAA identifier FRG.
